form.label: Process Tree Lab
form.description: Select a process-event data source and schema, apply optional filter SPL, and investigate process relationships.

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local count=0 /services/data/indexes | search disabled=0 isInternal=0 | rename title as index | fields index | where NOT match(index,"(?i)(^_|audit)") | sort 0 index | head 200
index=$data_index|s$ | stats count by sourcetype | sort 0 - count | head 200
index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ | stats count by source | sort 0 - count | head 500
index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ | stats count by EventCode | sort 0 - count | head 500
index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ | stats count by host | sort 0 host | head 100

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(pt_image) as pt_image latest(pt_pid) as pt_pid by pt_entity | eval root_label=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","")." (PID ".pt_pid.")" | sort 0 first_seen | head 100

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(pt_image) as pt_image latest(pt_entity) as pt_entity by pt_pid | eval process_name=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval pid_label=process_name." (PID ".pt_pid.") · ".strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort 0 first_seen | head 1000

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ | where isnotnull(pt_parent_image) AND isnotnull(pt_image) AND isnotnull(pt_parent_pid) AND isnotnull(pt_pid) | sort 0 _time | eval parent=replace(pt_parent_image,"^.*\\\\","")." (PID ".pt_parent_pid.")" | eval child=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","")." (PID ".pt_pid.")" | eval detail=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")." ".pt_command_line | fields child parent detail | pstree child=child parent=parent detail=detail spaces=50 | where mvfind(tree,"\\(PID ".$pstree_pid|s$."\\)")>=0 | table tree

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ | where isnotnull(pt_parent_image) AND isnotnull(pt_image) AND isnotnull(pt_parent_pid) AND isnotnull(pt_pid) | sort 0 _time | eval parent=replace(pt_parent_image,"^.*\\\\","")." (PID ".pt_parent_pid.")" | eval child=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","")." (PID ".pt_pid.")" | eval detail=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")." ".pt_command_line | fields child parent detail | pstree child=child parent=parent detail=detail spaces=50 | where like(lower(mvjoin(tree,"\n")),"%".lower($pstree_hunt|s$)."%") | head 3 | eval tree=mvindex(tree,0,199) | table tree

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ pt_parent_entity=$root_guid|s$ (pt_image=$process_filter|s$ OR pt_parent_image=$process_filter|s$) | eval child_name=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eventstats count as edge_count by pt_parent_image pt_image | where edge_count>=tonumber($min_count|s$) | timechart span=1h cont=false count as events by child_name limit=10 useother=true

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ pt_parent_entity=$root_guid|s$ (pt_image=$process_filter|s$ OR pt_parent_image=$process_filter|s$) | eval parent_name=replace(pt_parent_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval child_name=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval source=if($node_mode|s$="pid",parent_name." (PID ".pt_parent_pid.")",parent_name) | eval target=if($node_mode|s$="pid",child_name." (PID ".pt_pid.")",child_name) | stats count as value by source target | where value>=tonumber($min_count|s$) | sort 0 - value | head 80 | table source target value

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ pt_parent_entity=$root_guid|s$ (pt_image=$process_filter|s$ OR pt_parent_image=$process_filter|s$) | eval parent_name=replace(pt_parent_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval child_name=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval src_ip=if($node_mode|s$="pid",parent_name." (PID ".pt_parent_pid.")",parent_name) | eval dest_ip=if($node_mode|s$="pid",child_name." (PID ".pt_pid.")",child_name) | stats count by src_ip dest_ip | where count>=tonumber($min_count|s$) | sort 0 - count | head 80 | table src_ip dest_ip count

index=$data_index|s$ sourcetype=$data_sourcetype|s$ source=$data_source|s$ EventCode=$data_eventcode|s$ $filter_spl$ | eval pt_parent_image='$pt_parent_image_field$', pt_image='$pt_image_field$', pt_parent_pid='$pt_parent_pid_field$', pt_pid='$pt_pid_field$', pt_command_line=coalesce('$pt_command_line_field$',""), pt_user=coalesce('$pt_user_field$',"") | eval pt_parent_entity=coalesce(ParentProcessGuid,tostring(pt_parent_pid)), pt_entity=coalesce(ProcessGuid,tostring(pt_pid)) | search host=$host|s$ pt_parent_entity=$root_guid|s$ (pt_image=$process_filter|s$ OR pt_parent_image=$process_filter|s$) | eval parent_name=replace(pt_parent_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval child_name=replace(pt_image,"^.*\\\\","") | eval parent_process=if($node_mode|s$="pid",parent_name." (PID ".pt_parent_pid.")",parent_name) | eval child_process=if($node_mode|s$="pid",child_name." (PID ".pt_pid.")",child_name) | eventstats count as edge_count by pt_parent_image pt_image | where edge_count>=tonumber($min_count|s$) | eval lineage_key=lower(pt_parent_entity)." -> ".lower(pt_entity) | table _time parent_process child_process edge_count pt_user pt_command_line lineage_key | sort 0 _time | head 80
